limitations: Single-node CPU fixed-grid, 1D Cartesian hydro only.
No MPI CUDA, static/dynamic AMR, source-physics or checkpoint/restart expansion.
256-step trajectory checks are not a general long-time stability guarantee.
No scaling speedup claim; this is correctness evidence on a virtualized host.
Windows/MS-MPI and multi-node transports remain untested.
GitHub publication is tracked separately; migration is not publication.
execution_recovery: Output-directory separation in runner r1 only; no mathematical or solver change.
